oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an Oil Control System (OCS) that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Under light conditions (freeway driving, city driving on flat/moderate hills, no towing or heavy loads, no extended engine idling), the OCS displays a normal change interval. Under extreme conditions (repeated short trips under 5 miles, repeated short trips under 10 miles in below-freezing temps, hot weather stop-and-go traffic, extensive idling/low-speed driving, car-top carrier use, frequent braking or mountainous driving, sustained high-speed driving), the OCS triggers an early change indicator. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). If the indicator resets prematurely or becomes inoperative, change the oil within six months or 5,000 miles (8,000 km) from the last oil change.
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
Towing a trailer, using a camper or using a car-top carrier
extraction_caveats: 1. The maintenance schedule is presented as milestone columns (every 5,000 mi up to 120,000 mi/144 mo); repeat intervals were reconstructed by identifying the pattern across columns. 2. Brake fluid replacement appears at every 10k standard milestone (10k, 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k) and also at every severe milestone (10k, 20k, 30k, etc.). The original extraction incorrectly stated standard was 10k first then 20k repeat, and severe was 20k/24mo. Both are actually every 10k mi/12 mo. 3. Engine drive belts inspection first appears at 40,000 mi/48 mo in the schedule, then repeats every 10,000 mi/12 mo thereafter (at 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k). 4. Engine valve clearance has no specific mileage interval published — only a condition-based trigger ('inspect only if valve noise increases'). 5. Fluid capacities for ATF show '3-1/8 gal' for both with and without tow package as printed (11.9 L vs 11.6 L round to the same US gallon fraction in the manual). 6. The manual covers schedules up to 120,000 miles/144 months, with instruction to continue at the same intervals thereafter. 7. Pages provided do not include transfer fluid capacity or brake fluid specification details. 8. In-cabin microfilter first appears at 15k, then 30k, 60k, 90k, 105k — the pattern is not perfectly uniform but first at 15k then approximately every 30k. 9. Intelligent Key battery first appears at 15k (as inspection), then at 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k — first at 15k then every 30k. 10. Exhaust system under standard schedule appears at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k (every 20k), not every 10k. Steering gear & linkage and axle & suspension parts similarly appear at 20k intervals under standard. 11. Spark plugs and ATF each appear only once in the schedule (at 105k and 90k respectively); repeat intervals beyond 120k are not explicitly shown. 12. Engine coolant first replacement at 105k mi/84 mo, then every 75k mi/60 mo per page 611.
